## Meeting Purpose

[Review Adrian's "ByteClub" project and discuss potential leads.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=815.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**ByteClub:** A PWA for corporate canteens solving 20% food waste by enabling weekly meal pre-orders.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=922.0)
  - [**Client Success:** A Portuguese construction firm cut food waste by 20% (saving \~€25k/mo) and eliminated kitchen chaos.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2043.0)
  - [**Pricing:** Current model is €5/user/month (€1k/mo ARR from the 200-user pilot). A per-meal fee (\~€0.20) is being considered for multi-company canteens.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2073.0)
  - [**New Lead:** Aki will pitch ByteClub to a contact becoming managing director of a Wiesack catering GmbH in January, opening a potential channel to Wiesack's 60,000+ employees.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2457.0)

## Topics

### Problem: Corporate Canteen Inefficiency

  - [**Client:** A Portuguese construction firm with 200 employees.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=922.0)
  - [**Pain Points:**](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=928.0)
      - [**20% Food Waste:** Over-production of \~50 meals/day.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=973.0)
      - [**Kitchen Chaos:** Unpredictable demand and employees taking extra food.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=949.0)
      - [**Inefficient Distribution:** Manual, paper-based meal tracking.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1584.0)

### Solution: ByteClub Platform

  - [**Core Function:** Employees pre-order meals for the week by Saturday evening.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=990.0)
  - [**Tech Stack:** Progressive Web App (PWA) on Vercel (frontend) and Superbase (backend).](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1028.0)
  - [**Key Features:**](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1003.0)
      - [**Menu Planner:** Drag-and-drop interface for kitchen staff to build weekly menus.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1003.0)
      - [**Employee Ordering:** PWA for weekly meal selection, with dietary filters (e.g., vegetarian, no pork).](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1113.0)
      - [**Kitchen Dashboard:** Real-time view of meal counts for efficient preparation.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1550.0)
      - [**Distribution Page:** Kitchen staff scan employee QR codes/NFC cards to confirm orders, preventing double-serving.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1811.0)
      - [**Reporting:** Generates shopping lists and printable menus.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1702.0)

### Future Development & Monetization

  - [**AI-Driven Menu Planning:**](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1267.0)
      - [**Inventory Optimization:** Suggests menus to use up expiring stock.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=1299.0)
      - [**Dietary Personalization:** Creates meal plans based on employee health goals.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2215.0)
  - [**Monetization Strategy:**](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2073.0)
      - [**Current:** €5/user/month.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2073.0)
      - [**Alternative:** Per-meal fee (\~€0.20) for multi-company canteens.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2298.0)
      - [**Rejected:** Revenue-share model (e.g., 20% of savings) was too hard to quantify.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2334.0)

### AI-Powered Productivity

  - [**Lead Generation:** Using Claude AI to build targeted lead lists.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=133.0)
  - [**Workflow Automation:** Using n8n to automate tasks like syncing new affiliates to Monday and a CRM.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=285.0)
  - [**Meeting Analysis:** Automating meeting summaries from transcripts, with future plans for AI-driven personality profiles and ticket creation.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=318.0)
  - [**Learning:** Using ChatGPT's "study mode" and the Feynman Technique to create personalized learning plans (e.g., for the MS-900 certification).](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=512.0)

## Next Steps

  - [**Aki:** Pitch ByteClub to a contact becoming managing director of a Wiesack catering GmbH in January.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2457.0)
  - [**Adrian:** Be available for a follow-up call on Saturday evening to support the pitch.](https://fathom.video/share/Jt7N5ryyFxiUzKku-BECkiMHP1wYV-sR?tab=summary&timestamp=2457.0)
